title: About - Misha Zubarev | Ariella Digital Consulting
description: Misha Zubarev was the first LumApps deployment consultant onboarded in the US in 2017, becoming a product deployment expert. He founded Ariella Digital Consulting in 2020.

nodes.html: About

ADC is a certified LumApps Technology and Implementation partner. Our founder was the first LumApps deployment consultant onboarded in the US, and we've served LumApps customers ever since. We're a boutique consulting and engineering firm specializing in deep integrations, AI (MCPs, Skills, Connectors), implementation, search, custom widget development, and enterprise UI/UX design. Our mission is simple: making LumApps a simpler, happier experience, for the teams who run it and the employees who use it every day.

c.html: Misha Zubarev
Founder and Managing Director

Misha founded ADC in 2020 and became a LumApps partner. As a former Lumie, and one of the first deployment specialists in North America, he brings creative thought partnership and cross-industry expertise to his customers to help solve for their unique enterprise challenges relating to Enterprise Search, Architecture & Taxonomy and Employee Productivity, through strategic and solutions-oriented consulting as well as custom integrations.

Misha's cross-industry experience includes Fintech, Healthcare, Gaming, Application Performance Management, Real Estate, among many others. This, combined with his deep product knowledge and customer experience positions him well to provide well rounded advice and be a trusted partner and advisor to his customers.
Learn More
Ivo Bellin Salarin
Technical Director

Experienced in all the fields of the Software Craftmanship, from the QA to the development, from the Product Ownership to the Engineering Management. Also an ex-Lumie, Ivo is very hands-on and solutions oriented, bringing the art of technical reality to life. Ivo has a strong passion for everything related to Search and AI, and In his words "I am persuaded that everything we imagine can be brought to reality - it's just a matter of determining your Most Valuable Product."
Learn More
Ariella Zubarev
Marketing DIretor

Ariella focuses on creating high-impact ADC content and delivering it across multiple channels to elevate brand visibility, deepen customer engagement, and support revenue objectives.

I develop content-driven marketing strategies that integrate with company goals — strengthening customer relationships and deliver measurable business value. My work spans digital marketing, content production, and customer storytelling.
Learn More
